purpose: Per-week hypothesis + ship metrics, captured over time. Public dashboard source: reach metrics only, no money fields.
metric_note: engaged_views, NOT public views — YouTube moved public view counting to play-start on 2026-08-24 (inflates raw views 1.3-2.4x vs earlier baselines).
cohort_rule: cohort_x = ship engaged views ÷ median engaged views of ships at the SAME AGE (age-matched; a flat 8-24d cohort flatters young ships ~2x because eng/day decays steeply).
